title: Tiered bulk pricing for embeddings + QSA prep for enterprise renewals
creator: Amina Patel
description: Goal: introduce a tiered per-vector pricing model with explicit bulk discounts for embeddings and a separate per-rank pricing proposal for reranking, plus complete answers and attachments for customer security questionnaires (QSA) to unblock enterprise renewals. This ticket covers product definition, experiment design, legal contract language proposals, and an ops migration path for existing customers who want to opt in to the new tiers. We must balance revenue neutrality for the first 90 days with simplified packaging that Sales can explain during renewals.
acceptance_criteria: Draft and agree on a 3-tier bulk discount matrix (Starter/Scale/Enterprise) for per-vector pricing and a sample per-rank reranking price with at least one low-cost micro-tier for high-volume customers.
Run a revenue-sensitivity model with expected usage curves for top 30 customers and show <=5% projected revenue variance vs current pricing at 60% adoption after 6 months.
Legal review: updated MSA/price addendum language drafted and QSA answers completed and attached (security-responses-v2.pdf) for common questions about data retention, KMS, and private deployment.
Experiment plan: A/B design for new signup flow + existing-customer opt-in with instrumentation (conversion, churn, ARPU, NRR) and dashboards defined in Console (pricing-experiment/embeddings-v1).
Migration plan documented: opt-in process, billing proration logic, rollback criteria, and support runbook for manual adjustments.
Sales enablement assets: one-pager, pricing calculator spreadsheet, and negotiation guardrails created and stored in Drive (links in comments).
comments: 2025-11-12 Amina Patel: Initial scoping meeting notes. Agreed to split work into two parallel tracks: (1) product + experiments, (2) legal + QSA attachments for renewals. Action items: PM to own experiment design, Legal to draft contract language, Finance to provide revenue model inputs.

2025-11-14 Liam O'Connor: Uploaded initial bulk tiers spreadsheet to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1XYZ-pricing-proposals. Proposed tiers: Starter (<=1M vectors/mo) $0.00040/vector, Scale (1M-100M) $0.00022/vector, Enterprise (>100M) custom with 35-55% discount. Asking Eng for telemetry on current vector distribution by customer.

2025-11-15 Sofia Zhang (Finance): Ran revenue sensitivity model using top 30 customers. Summary attached: https://s3.redwood/reports/embeddings-pricing-sensitivity-nov15.csv. Early result: if enterprise discounts are at 50% and adoption hits 50%, revenue could decline ~7% unless we increase unit price on Starter tier by ~8%.

2025-11-17 Priya Rao (Legal): Drafted MSA addendum language and QSA answers for common customer questions (data isolation, KMS integration, retention controls). Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/contracts/pull/412. Need Security review for KMS/HSM wording.

2025-11-18 Marcus Lee (Security): Reviewed QSA draft. Open items: clarify key rotation frequency and HSM ownership for Private deployments; suggest adding a separate appendix describing audit log retention and redaction policy. Pls see comments on PR.

2025-11-19 Liam O'Connor: Experiment plan sketched: cohorts = New signups (50/50) and existing eligible customers (opt-in e-mail + sales follow-up). Metrics: conversion to paid, tokens/vectors per account, ARPU delta, refund rate. Dashboard tickets: ENG-9156 (instrumentation) and ENG-9157 (billing proration).

Also need guardrails for custom discounts to avoid unbounded concessions. Added 'sales-guardrails.md' to Drive.

2025-11-20 Amina: Next steps: finalize tier numbers after legal/security clarifications, schedule a sync w/finance to agree revenue-neutrality boundaries, and open the PRD for stakeholder review. Assign ENG tickets for telemetry and billing changes.
